api_routes.runtime_notes: R entity path. O Q query parameters. 200 array of database rows; userfields added only when definitions exist. Entity API schema below defines fields. Invalid/unlistable entity 400; uncaught SQL/filter failures use global errors.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R entity and objectId paths. 200 database row with userfields map or null; missing row 404; invalid/unlistable entity 400. Stock userfields use stock_id instead of numeric row id.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R entity path and JSON column/value object (see entity dictionary). 200 {created_object_id}; not 201. Database constraints apply; no universal DTO validator. Product creation may auto-add missing products to shopping lists according to user settings.
api_routes.permissions: Entity-dependent mutation policy in [schema dictionary](react-api-schemas.md#generic-entity-policies).

api_routes.runtime_notes: R entity/objectId paths and JSON column/value object; supplied columns updated, 204. Missing row 400. Product updates may auto-add missing products. Do not PUT enriched response fields or userfields inside this object.
api_routes.permissions: Entity-dependent mutation policy in [schema dictionary](react-api-schemas.md#generic-entity-policies).

api_routes.runtime_notes: R entity/objectId paths; no body required. 204; missing object 400. Database triggers/cascades apply. SQL delete failures are not wrapped by a local catch.
api_routes.permissions: Entity-dependent mutation policy in [schema dictionary](react-api-schemas.md#generic-entity-policies).

api_routes.runtime_notes: R entity/objectId paths; entity accepts users and userentity-NAME in addition to exposed entities. 200 field-name/value map; empty definitions encode as [] rather than {}. No per-object existence check.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R entity/objectId and JSON field-name/value map. 204. Unknown entity/field 400. Writes supplied values individually; no all-or-nothing guarantee. For stock use stock_id; for custom objects use userentity-NAME with userobjects.id.
api_routes.permissions: MASTER_DATA_EDIT

api_routes.runtime_notes: R group and Base64 filename path; URL-encode the Base64 segment. Raw binary body, NOT JSON or multipart. 204. Exclusive file creation refuses overwrite; invalid group/name or I/O errors 400.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R group/Base64 filename. Optional Base64-stored-name_Base64-download-name syntax. O query force_serve_as=picture, best_fit_width, best_fit_height numeric. 200 binary with MIME type, inline Content-Disposition and 30-day cache. All caught failures become 404.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R group/Base64 filename; no body. 204; invalid group/name/I/O 400. Allowed groups in entity dictionary.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R userId and JSON username, first_name, last_name, password, picture_file_name; password_base64 optionally replaces password. 204. Self uses USERS_EDIT_SELF, others USERS_EDIT. Follow UsersService empty-password behavior.
api_routes.permissions: USERS_EDIT_SELF for self; USERS_EDIT for other user.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R userId. No body. 204. UsersService constraints/errors apply.
api_routes.permissions: USERS_EDIT

api_routes.permissions: ADMIN

api_routes.permissions: ADMIN

api_routes.runtime_notes: No parameters. 200 filtered collection of UserDto rows for current ID, NOT a singleton object.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R settingKey. 204; deletes override, so defaults may reappear on refetch.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: No implemented query options. 200 current stock row array enriched with product data; see service and schema dictionary. UI overview uses a different SQL view and additional filtering.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R entryId and JSON amount, open, purchased_date (last two directly read although not explicitly validated). api_routes.runtime_notes: O query due_soon_days numeric and nonempty, default 5 (0 falls back to 5). 200 {due_products,overdue_products,expired_products,missing_products}, each an array.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId. 200 ProductDetailsResponse with product/barcodes, units, locations, stock quantities/value, prices and dates. Missing/inactive product 400.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId; O include_sub_products boolean query, default false, and Q. 200 StockEntry[].
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId; O include_sub_products boolean query, default false, and Q. 200 StockLocation[].
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId. 200 array of {date,price,shopping_location}; invalid/inactive product 400.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId and JSON amount:number >0 in stock units (tare mode uses gross weight). O best_before_date:date default service-derived; purchased_date:date default today; price, location_id, shopping_location_id default null; transaction_type default purchase; stock_label_type default 0; note default null. 200 StockLogEntry[]. Date defaults include shelf-life/freezer rules, not always today.
api_routes.permissions: STOCK_PURCHASE

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId and amount:number. O spoiled=false, stock_entry_id="default", location_id=null, recipe_id=null, exact_amount=false, allow_subproduct_substitution=false. 200 StockLogEntry[]. transaction_type is checked but transactiontype is read: preserve as a known defect, do not promise a supported override. Amount uses stock units; service handles tare, shortage, substitution and entry ordering.
api_routes.permissions: STOCK_CONSUME

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId and JSON amount, location_id_from, location_id_to. O stock_entry_id="default". 200 StockLogEntry[]. Service validates source stock and locations, applies freezer/thawing date rules.
api_routes.permissions: STOCK_TRANSFER

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId and new_amount (not amount). O best_before_date, purchased_date, location_id, price, shopping_location_id, note default null; stock_label_type=0. 200 StockLogEntry[]. Equal current amount errors; service selects purchase/consume adjustment.
api_routes.permissions: STOCK_INVENTORY

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productId and amount. O stock_entry_id="default", allow_subproduct_substitution=false. 200 StockLogEntry[]. Opening can split entries/change due dates; disabled opening, tare products or shortage can fail.
api_routes.permissions: STOCK_OPEN

api_routes.runtime_notes: R productIdToKeep/productIdToRemove integer paths; no body. 204; validates both active, distinct products. Related database records migrate; refetch master data and stock.

Amount uses stock units; service handles tare, shortage, substitution and entry ordering.

api_routes.permissions: STOCK_TRANSFER

O best_before_date, purchased_date, location_id, price, shopping_location_id, note default null; stock_label_type=0. 200 StockLogEntry[]. Equal current amount errors; service selects purchase/consume adjustment.
api_routes.permissions: STOCK_INVENTORY

Resolves barcode before delegating; outer catch maps delegated exceptions, including permission failures, to 400. amount. O stock_entry_id="default", allow_subproduct_substitution=false. 200 StockLogEntry[]. Opening can split entries/change due dates; disabled opening, tare products or shortage can fail.

api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.permissions: STOCK_EDIT

api_routes.runtime_notes: R transactionId string; no body. 200 StockLogEntry[]; missing/empty transaction 400. Distinguish transaction ID from booking ID, numeric stock row ID and string stock_id.

api_routes.permissions: STOCK_EDIT

O query add: literal "true" reliably enables insertion; code also checks integer 1, so do not rely on query string "1". 200 plugin-derived object, potentially creating product, barcode, picture and conversion. Depends on configured plugin/network; missing plugin/duplicate product can fail.

GET executes webhook when LABEL_PRINTER_RUN_SERVER is enabled; otherwise frontend must invoke configured hook with returned data. Disable caching/prefetch/retries for this action; errors 400.

api_routes.permissions: SHOPPINGLIST_ITEMS_ADD

api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: Optional recipeId path distinguishes two registered routes. No ID: O Q, 200 RecipeFulfillmentResponse[]. With ID: 200 RecipeFulfillmentResponse; missing recipe 400. Do not add servings query parameters; persisted recipe desired_servings drives calculations.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: JSON {} allowed. O chore_id numeric/nonempty: one chore; absent recalculates all. 204. No explicit action permission check.
api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.

api_routes.runtime_notes: R taskId. No body. 204. Sets done=0 and done_timestamp=null; missing task 400.

api_routes.permissions: Authenticated; no explicit action permission check.
